design_parameters.enrich_notes: Water Quality storm is defined as 1.5 inches of rainfall volume (Table 4.3-A), not a frequency event. WQ compliance may infiltrate the water quality volume or remove 80% TSS from Water Quality storm discharge (Section 4.2.3). Detention outlet design references iSWM Hydraulics TM Section 2.2.3 for extended detention outlets (Section 4.9.6). Construction sediment basins require outlet dewatering between 36 and 72 hours (Section 4.13.4). Open channel design includes swales designed for Flood Mitigation storm (Section 4.6.3).
